description: Payout parameters used by analysis/. Towers values come from the captured client code (evidence/client/) and the historical help pages (evidence/help-history/). Comparator values are the stated edge and per-row odds; see CLAIMS.md C05 for which of them have a retained source.

towers.client_step_note: client_step_number is the JavaScript Number returned by new BigNumber(choices/(choices-bombs)).times(1-houseEdge).toNumber() in roundMultiplier (evidence/client/towers-chunk-2026-10-07/1828.89aa27f6.js, byte 33117). BigNumber multiplies in decimal, so the results are the doubles nearest 1.425, 1.9 and 2.85, not the binary product (3/2)*(1-0.05).

limits.description: Published caps and rounded maximum Medium stakes (evidence/help-history/, evidence/client/limits-article-2026-10-07/).

stake_dragon_tower_master.status: guide and game page state 2% edge / 98% RTP; guide states Master first 3.92x and top 256,901.12x; game-event rules (captured 2026-10-28) state 9 game events and Master = 1 egg in 4 tiles; rows 2-8 are calculated (not published per row in the retained pages)

shuffle_tower_hard.status: official chart (captured 2026-10-28) lists all nine Hard (1/2) values, stated as truncated to 2 dp; game-event rules state 9 rows and Hard = 1 key in 2 columns; the chart values equal the calculation
